about.intro: Lucchi is a furniture brand and showroom in Egypt, creating living room, bedroom, dining, kids bedroom, and accessory pieces for private homes, designers, and projects.
about.metaDescription: About Lucchi Furniture — a furniture brand and showroom in Egypt, creating living room, bedroom, dining, kids bedroom, and accessory pieces for private homes, designers, and projects.

sections.body: Every piece is shaped around proportion, comfort, and the quality of its materials, from a single piece to a complete room.
sections.heading: Our approach

sections.body: We work with materials such as Romanian red beech wood, natural and HPL veneers, Italian Calacatta marble, 304 stainless steel, and velvet, mohair, and linen fabrics.
sections.heading: Materials

home.contactCopy: Lucchi Furniture is made in Cairo from solid Romanian red beech and natural veneers. Visit the showroom to see the pieces up close, or learn more about how we work.
home.heroParagraph: A private furniture destination for considered interiors. Solid Romanian red beech structures, bookmatched natural veneers, and curated pieces available by enquiry.
